description: Look up an element by name, symbol or atomic number; calculate molar mass of a formula including hydrates; balance a chemical equation; calculate molarity, dilution or grams; look up a compound and its reported hazards; find a physical constant or convert scientific units. Calculations show their working and compounds use live PubChem data. Applies to questions about chemical elements, chemistry math, compounds, physical constants and science unit conversions.

c2.description: Final concentration for dilution, or mol/L for grams

equation.description: Unbalanced equation, e.g. H2 + O2 -> H2O

formula.description: Chemical formula, for molar_mass or solution grams, e.g. CuSO4·5H2O

from_unit.description: Source unit, e.g. km, g, L, C

kind.description: Choose the science question to answer

mode.description: Solution calculation; for dilution leave exactly one of c1, v1, c2, v2 out

query.description: Element name, symbol or atomic number; compound name; or constant name or symbol

to_unit.description: Target unit of the same dimension

value.description: Value to convert, with from_unit and to_unit

volume_l.description: Solution volume in litres for molarity or grams

name: check_chemistry
title: Chemistry: elements, compounds and constants
